program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let ((h (rows g))
               (w (cols g)))
           (grid-from-fn h
                         w
                         (lambda (r c)
                           (let ((hits (filter (lambda (cell)
                                                 (let ((cr (fst cell))
                                                       (cc (snd cell)))
                                                   (or
                                                     (and (= r cr) (>= c cc))
                                                     (and (= c (- w 1)) (>= r cr)))))
                                               (filter (lambda (cell)
                                                         (!= 0 (third cell)))
                                                       (grid-cells g)))))
                             (if (null? hits) 0 (third (last hits)))))))))
